_about: Public-domain Francis Paget (1851-1911), Dean of Christ Church and Bishop of Oxford, for the Word Hoard: Concerning Spiritual Gifts (1881), The Redemption of Work (1882), Faculties and Difficulties for Belief and Disbelief (1889), The Spirit of Discipline (1891), The Hallowing of Work (1892), Studies in the Christian Character (1895), An Introduction to the Fifth Book of Hooker's Ecclesiastical Polity (1899), and Christ the Way (1902). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 75 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
